name: pdf-card-mcp
description: Convert local PDFs into standalone reader pages, validate notes/highlights, and publish static annotated bundles with optional stronger local table detection.
long_description: PDF Card Reader is a local-first MCP tool for turning dense PDFs into minimal HTML readers inspired by the source document. It derives safe reader styling from local PDF palette hints, supports local notes/highlights as a separate sidecar, and can validate or publish static annotated reader bundles. This full variant installs the optional local ML table detector for stronger table crops while keeping deterministic document processing on-device.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_card_html
tools.description: Convert a local PDF into a standalone card-based HTML reader with PDF-inspired styling and embedded source-page, table, figure, and formula images.

tools.name: validate_reader_annotations
tools.description: Validate a notes/highlights annotation sidecar against a generated reader HTML file.

tools.name: publish_reader_bundle
tools.description: Publish a generated reader as a single static HTML file or directory bundle with selected public notes and highlights.
